blocks.text: Analytics within the Zscaler Admin Console provides a comprehensive set of dashboards and reports that allow you to monitor end-user digital experience, cyber risk, deployment health, etc. Teams across your organization (e.g., security, IT, procurement, etc.) can use the various dashboards and reports to manage security posture, deliver fast digital experiences, and maximize cost savings.

The following table lists the various dashboards and reports available in the Zscaler Admin Console's Analytics section. The dashboards and reports you have access to are dependent upon the Zscaler subscriptions that apply for your organization.

table: Delivers centralized visibility into the deployment, health, and performance of your Zscaler environment. Dashboards and reports: Best Practices: Displays the best practices distilled from Zscaler's extensive experience in deploying and managing numerous ecosystems. Connectors Health: Focuses on the various devices used to connect to the Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE). China Connectivity: Provides a near real-time overview of your China Premium connectivity, which gives you visibility into the current and historic bandwidth utilization against purchased bandwidth. Adoption: Displays Zscaler platform adoption maturity by detailing deployment, entitlement, and utilization levels on a per-product basis. Executive Insights: Provides a high-level overview of the applications, network, cloud, and incidents in your organization.

Analyzes your organization's security data and provides real-time risk metrics to quantify the risk at the organization level and 4 major attack stages (i.e., External Attack Surface, Compromise, Lateral Propogation, and Data Loss). Dashboards and reports: Factors: Shows the list of contributing factors that are affecting your organization's risk score. Assets: Aggregates and visualizes the total number of assets in your organization, highlights risky assets, and further provides drilldowns on these risky assets to understand what's driving the risk. Insights: Gives visibility into your organization's current risks and vulnerabilities. Financial Risk: Gives visibility into your organization's potential financial loss exposure for your current risk score. Alerts: Helps you meet your security compliance requirements and reduce potential financial losses by getting timely notifications when the configured criteria in the alert rule are met. MITRE ATT&CK: Highlights each attacker's journey from the point of access to a potential data exfiltration, among other harmful acts. PCI DSS: Provides data related to the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), which is a mandatory security framework for all entities that store, process, or transmit cardholder's payment data. NIST CSF: Provides data related to the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) cybersecurity framework (CSF), as well as guidance on how to respond and recover from a security breach event. NIST SP 800-53: Provides data related to the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Special Publication (SP) 800-53, which is a set of structured security and privacy controls applicable specifically to federal information systems and organizations. NIS2: Provides data related to the Network and Information Security Directive 2 (NIS2), which is a European Union (EU) law that aims to improve cybersecurity across member states. ISO 27001: Provides data related to the ISO 27001, which is a set of standards for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an information security management system (ISMS) for any organization. HITRUST: Provides data related to the HITRUST compliance, which is a comprehensive and certifiable security framework that integrates with multiple standards to help organizations with risk compliance and cyber resilience. HIPAA: Provides data related to the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), which is a mandatory compliance framework for the healthcare industry or entities that interact with the United States' patient health information (PHI). DORA: Provides data related to the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), a European Union (EU) regulation for the financial sector that mandates strong cybersecurity resilience and risk management for financial entities and critical Information and Communication Technology (ICT) third-party providers. CIS: Provides data related to the Center for Internet Security (CIS) Critical Security Controls, which are a prescriptive, tactical, prioritized, and simplified set of best practices designed to strengthen your cybersecurity posture. CAF: Provides data related to the Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) is a standardized, outcome-focused compliance developed by the UK's National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) in 2018 to help organizations evaluate and improve their cyber resilience. SOC 2: Provides data related to the System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2) standard, which is a voluntary compliance framework created by the AICPA that evaluates how well a service organization securely manages customer data. GDPR: Provides data related to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), which is a privacy law created by the European Union (EU) that gives individuals control over their personal information.

Provides 360-degree visibility into your organization's SaaS application usage and spending insights, along with workplace metrics to help you save money and manage your workplace efficiently. Dashboards and reports: Application Insights: Provides a holistic overview of the applications that are currently being used across your organization. All Applications: Shows the list of apps whose usage is discovered within your organization. Application Settings: Lets you configure an application connector or customer application signature for which you want to view insights. Workplace Insights: Provides metrics related to workplaces and their workforces across the globe for an organization. Offices and Locations: Provides data for Internet & SaaS (ZIA) locations and inferred IP addresses. Workplace Settings: Provides information about the offices that you configured for your organization. Data Explorer: Provides attendance and operations metrics about the offices that you configured for your organization.

Provides information about malicious activity that affects your organization. On the Cybersecurity dashboard, you can filter by time range and use the following widgets to track malicious activity across your organization: Your Cybersecurity Transactions from Last ___ Days Advanced Threat Categories Top Threat Locations Sandbox Threats Your SSL/TLS Inspection Review

Provides information about incidents, users, channels, and data at rest in your organization that might indicate areas at risk of data loss or leakage. Dashboards and reports: Inline CASB: Provides detailed information about data loss incidents from web applications in your organization. Inline DLP: Provides detailed information about data loss incidents from inline (web) sources in your organization. SaaS Security: Provides detailed information about data loss incidents from SaaS applications in your organization. Endpoint: Provides detailed information about data loss incidents from endpoints (e.g., printers, network shares, removable storage) in your organization. Email: Provides detailed information about data loss incidents from email that affect your organization. Incidents: Provides high-level visibility and insight into your organization's Data Loss Prevention (DLP) incidents.

Provides a multi-tenant, cloud-based monitoring platform to probe, benchmark, and measure the digital experiences for every single user within your organization. Dashboards and reports: Incidents: Provides an overview of incidents affecting your organization. Network Intelligence: Provides end-to-end multi-path network visibility from Last Mile Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE) to applications. Applications Overview: Provides an overview of application performance in your organization. Devices Overview: Provides a comprehensive device health scoreboard that monitors the performance of devices.

Provides a series of dashboards and reports for Zscaler Client Connector, Cloud & Branch Connector, and Zero Trust Branch. Dashboards and reports: Client Connector: A lightweight, tamper-resistant software agent installed on end-user devices that automatically forwards all user and device traffic through the ZTE for security inspection, policy enforcement, and secure access to both internet and internal resources, regardless of user location. The following Zscaler Client Connector dashboards and reports are available: Platform Details: Provides OS platform details such as device model and device state. Device Overview: Provides an overview of the devices in use in your organization. Device Posture: Provides an overview of criteria evaluated on devices in your organization. Device Events: Provides an overview of Private Access (ZPA) and Internet & SaaS (ZIA) service status for your organization. Connector Activity: Provides an overview of Cloud Connector and Branch Connector activity in your organization. Zero Trust Branch: Provides customizable widgets that display important information about the assets, VLANs, gateways, and devices in your organization to give you a real-time overview of your organization's security operations.

In addition to a robust set of preconfigured dashboards that allow you to monitor your organization's security profile at a glance using a variety of graphs and charts, you can also create customized dashboards so you can focus on the metrics most important to you. Custom dashboards allow you to view real-time data, and collaborate and share those dashboards with others in your organization in similar or related job functions.

Provides a series of dashboards and reports that highlight security data for key entities across your organization. Dashboards and reports: Industry Peer Comparison: Compares your organization's performance and effectiveness for the preceding month to that of both peer organizations and all companies using the cloud service. System Audit Report: Highlights the status of GRE tunnels, PAC files, authentication frequency, PAC file sizes, Microsoft 365 One Click, and IP visibility. Security Policy Audit Report: Allows you to view your Security Policy settings and improve them by following best practices guidelines. Sandbox Activity Report: Highlights the Sandbox policy action taken for known and unknown files in your organization. SaaS Security Report: Provides a breakdown of applications by their status — sanctioned, unsanctioned, unclassified, or under review and their number of users. It also shows the application categories, the risk index, and the certifications for each application. Configuration Risk Report: Provides an evaluation of your organization's policy configuration, traffic patterns, and feature capabilities against Zscaler's best practices. IOT Discovery Report: Provides a device inventory and insights discovered from unauthenticated web traffic in your organization. Risk360 Reports: Provides links to download various risk-related reports from the Reports page. ZPA QBR Reports: Provide extensive insight into emerging traffic trends based on private application usage and the types of threats Zscaler blocks to protect your network. ZDX QBR Reports: Provides extensive insight into how Zscaler is helping protect your network, quarter to quarter. Interactive Reports: Provides a wide range of standard reports, based on your organization's subscriptions, and provides the ability to create up to 500 custom reports, as well.
